title: The passive with ser: who was overthrown and what was closed

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know the passive with *ser* + past participle from B1 Unit 18 (*La ley fue aprobada por el Parlamento*). The participle agrees with the subject, and *por* names who did the action. It is common in history, when the result matters more than the actor: who was overthrown, what was closed, what was elected.

items.spanish: En Brasil, el presidente João Goulart fue derrocado por los militares en 1964.
items.english: In Brazil, President João Goulart was overthrown by the military in 1964.

items.spanish: El primer presidente militar fue elegido por el Congreso.
items.english: The first military president was elected by Congress.

items.spanish: En 1965 los partidos políticos fueron disueltos.
items.english: In 1965 the political parties were dissolved.

items.spanish: El Congreso fue cerrado durante varios meses.
items.english: Congress was closed for several months.

sections.content: The participle matches the subject: *el Congreso fue cerrado*, *los partidos fueron disueltos*. Use *por* + actor only when it matters who acted (*derrocado por los militares*).
